title: The Lie About "U.S. Citizenship"
summary: Substack post selling a 'national status and passport' course, claiming 14th Amendment citizens are federal property without Bill of Rights protection and that national passports carry a do-not-detain code.

assertions.quote: a national passport has a “Do Not Detain” code embedded within it
If you’re ready to leave the bankrupt corporation and its control over your life, you would start the National Status & Passport process
Therefore, U.S. citizens do not have access to the Bill of Rights!

verdicts.note: Courts apply the Bill of Rights to all citizens, and the 14th Amendment incorporated most of it against the states.

assertions.quote: the U.S. citizens (14th Amendment) residing in one of the states of the union, are classified as property and franchises of the federal government
The “U.S. citizen” status was introduced much later in 1868 with the fraudulently ratified 14th Amendment

verdicts.note: The 14th Amendment was certified in 1868 and courts have rejected challenges to its ratification.

assertions.quote: what if you were to submit a notarized affidavit – the highest form of truth in law – to said passport-issuing authority

verdicts.note: An affidavit is sworn evidence a court weighs; silence from an agency does not make it binding.
The court found no authority that maxims like 'an unrebutted affidavit stands as truth in commerce' have binding force, and held that non-response created no estoppel.
The IRS's non-response to taxpayer demands has never relieved anyone of the duty to pay tax, contrary to the idea that unanswered paperwork binds the agency.
'Maxims' such as 'an unrebutted affidavit stands as truth in commerce' are spurious US pseudolaw, and 'failure to respond to an affidavit proves facts' was implicitly rejected.

assertions.quote: A “U.S. citizen” is collateral property of the bankrupt United States Federal Corporation
